_class_a_content_version_doc: D38-frozen per-record `canonical_content_version`/`publication_unit` literal for the class-A identities (`repository-bootstrap-map.json`) — embedded into every class-A projection body and NEVER moves, even when `configs/publication-versions.json` units.repository-bootstrap (the umbrella/lock version) advances. Decoupling this from the umbrella version keeps existing class-A projection BYTES byte-identical across an owner bump; only the new identity, combined lock and class-B projections track the expanded inventory.
